title: Protocol Requirements with Defaults
hints: Protocol requirements can't have default argument values.
Add a one-parameter `send(_:)` in a protocol extension that forwards `urgent: false`.
`extension Notifier { func send(_ message: String) -> String { send(message, urgent: false) } }`.
jsBridge: Protocol requirements can't declare default argument values, so you add an overload in a protocol extension that forwards with the default. TS interfaces can mark parameters optional (`urgent?: boolean`), which Swift can't express in a protocol.
